workouts.name: NEW 4day Split · Easy Jog (Tue)
workouts.notes:
Aerobic base day. It should feel easy: you should be able to talk in full sentences while jogging.

Outside if possible; treadmill on rainy days or when short on time.

Main block is 30 min — adjust between 25 and 35 min.

exercises.name: Brisk walk
exercises.notes: Warm up at a brisk pace.

exercises.name: Easy jog
exercises.notes: Continuous jog, a lot slower than your interval base jog. You should be able to talk in full sentences.

workouts.name: NEW 4day Split · Intervals (Thu)
workouts.notes:
Intervals: 7 × (1 min fast + 3 min base jog). The fast part is about 2 km/h above your base jog.

Progression: every 1–2 weeks, slightly raise the fast speed OR add one interval — never both at once.

exercises.name: Easy jog
exercises.notes: Easy jog to finish the warm up.

exercises.name: Fast
exercises.notes: About 2 kilometers per hour above your base jog.

exercises.name: Base jog
exercises.notes: Back to your base jog pace.

workouts.name: NEW 4day Split · Incline Walk 12-5-30 (Sat)
workouts.notes:
Saturday after Lower 2. Treadmill: 12% incline · 5 km/h · 30 min.

Don't hold the rails; stand tall and take steady steps.

exercises.name: Incline walk
exercises.notes: 12 percent incline, 5 kilometers per hour. Don't hold the rails.
